data.name: Ahmad
data.gender_notes: Ahmad is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Elative form of the root ح-م-د (ḥ-m-d), 'to praise' — 'more/most praiseworthy'. Its root is ح-م-د (ḥ-m-d). A name of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, mentioned in Qur'an 61:6. Ahmad is a Arabic name meaning “Most praiseworthy; more commendable”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ahmad expresses “Most praiseworthy; more commendable”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Elative form of the root ح-م-د (ḥ-m-d), 'to praise' — 'more/most praiseworthy'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ahmad total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
